intro: Bartleby's Mug is the personal drinking vessel of the stubborn brawler Bartleby in Stormwind. Surrendered only after a tavern brawl and emptied down to the last drop, it serves as proof of a warrior's ability to forcefully persuade an uncooperative opponent.

p: To the casual tavern regular, Bartleby's Mug is nothing more than ordinary drinkware clutched tight by a notoriously stubborn drinker. For a novice warrior training in Stormwind, however, wrestling the vessel away from Bartleby is a test of sheer physical dominance. Bartleby will not relinquish his beloved mug until knocked into submission—and even then, he insists on draining every last drop before handing it over as a trophy.
